decision.reason: [ev-de978b4c1ed8] is only a procedural step in the upgrade guide. It tells operators to check their cluster for "removed features" and links to a #removed-features section, but that section is not shown. It does not name any removed feature, API, field or flag, does not say what changed, and does not say what happens to a cluster that still uses one. To write subject, change, applicability and consequence, we need the individual removed-feature sections, and each of those is probably a separate change.
